findings.title: Unbounded in-memory sessions and file ingestion can create an availability risk
findings.impact: A browser session leak, very large CSV, or repeated uploads can grow process memory without backpressure and degrade or crash the local runtime.
findings.remediation: Add upload/file-size limits, explicit session TTL/eviction, and large-file guidance; consider streaming if large-data support is a product goal.

findings.title: Transport parity tests can miss semantic drift when they rely on source-text parsing
evidence: src/api/app.rs:24-35 defines the authoritative route list
findings.impact: Formatting or declaration refactors can make parity tests brittle or incomplete without exercising actual route or invoke behavior.
findings.remediation: Prefer exported route/command manifests or integration-level transport contract tests that call normal builders and invokes.

findings.title: Validation evidence was not produced during the read-only audit
findings.impact: Hidden type, lint, platform, or test regressions remain unverified until CI or local validation runs.
findings.remediation: Run or attach a fresh passing validation suite before release or merge readiness claims.
